subject: Re: Status - make the diversity result the headline
body:
Gustavo - flip the write-up. The reproduction is table stakes; the score-vs-coverage trade is the thing worth other people's attention. Lead with the -9% mean score / 3x backbone coverage number and the explanation of why score-greedy selection collapses. That paragraph is the most useful thing this project produced.

Decision on scope: we are dropping the non-antibody design round from May 26. Two weeks isn't enough to pick a problem, get data and run a round honestly, and a rushed one would undercut the diversity argument. Instead the write-up names three candidate problems and what each would need. Bruno, that frees Wanjiru back to 15% from May 11.

Hana, cc'ing you because I think this is a two-page internal note that a lot of teams should read, not a project post-mortem.

Anders
